blocks.text: SOP: Harbor & Oak product CSV load

This is the working cut for HBR-SOP-2022-012 on February 17, 2022. Paige Holcomb asked for a written bound after the current path (Matrixify-style CSV from Paige, 412 SKUs) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host sync.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on let Shopify mint handles for blank SKUs, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Dry-run prints row counts. Blank SKU is a hard stop. Image map is filename equals SKU. No Shopify auto-handle. I am not restating a hallway yes. let Shopify mint handles for blank SKUs is out because February 3 minted 6 handles Dana could not find. Paige spent 1.7 hours renaming. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at rows=412, blank=6, hours=1.7, dry=0.4, cols=18, miss=2, weeks=1, stop=1. Sibling tickets HBR-2715 and HBR-SYS-2021-070. I will not reopen let Shopify mint handles for blank SKUs in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: photos.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (18): refuse on let Shopify mint handles for blank SKUs, lock is dry-run, blank SKU stop, filename=SKU. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2715.
If the CSV has a blank SKU, stop. Do not invent one because Shopify allowed it last time.

What a skeptical user would try first on sync.harbor.internal: the path Paige Holcomb actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on shop.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

# stop. write the last error in one sentence on HBR-2715
# do not publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon

items: Write the symptom on HBR-2715 before any write.
